description: Project-scoped Claude Code settings for money-tracker.online. The guardrails that must apply to every checkout live in .claude/hooks, where a rule can carry its reasoning and a test; the allow list carries only the tracker operations the om-* pipeline cannot run without. The deny list is the exception to that split and is deliberately tiny: it repeats a handful of hook rules for the case the hooks cannot cover - this file being edited, the script erroring, or a mode that skips it - and it cannot explain itself, so it stays too short to reason with. deny wins over ask and allow in every mode, including the dontAsk a cezar run uses and the bypassPermissions of the review job. Every other permission rule stays per-developer in the gitignored .claude/settings.local.json.
